wrap.note: Both wrap edges fall on the centre line of a 1/16 in joint (2 px each side), so the edge columns/rows are joint on both sides of the wrap.

internal_seams.note: ratio ~1 means the overlap bands where DP seams run carry no extra step energy

cross_cell_similarity.note: Pearson correlation of cell i against cell j and its flipH/flipV/rot180, all 36 pairs. The joint frame is identical in every cell, so the with-joints figure has a floor from it.

repetition.note: Blocks reuse source areas (the pool holds ~4.6 faces of real stone for 9 faces); the local NCC shows where a 6 in window of one face reappears, in any of 8 orientations, in another face.

swatch.tone: lighting flatten sigma 10 in (field range is +-0.6 levels)

gates.1_photographic_only: every stone pixel is resampled/flipped/rotated photo content or a feathered blend of photo content; no synthetic noise or pattern generators are used (see README method)

5_scale.floor_resample: single-step plane resampling at 64 px/in from the photo
